Name: Bridge to Blue Moon Vineyard
Author: AndrewJamesC
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][color=#6aa84f][size=3]﻿[b]Backstory[/b][/size][/color][/font][/center]﻿
﻿So, nearly a year ago, I had a dream that I was the farmer in-game, and that I travelled across a wooden bridge with a leaf roof. Like, that was literally it. And ever since then, I've just wanted to have [i]that[/i] bridge in the game. So, here it is! 

[center][b][font=Georgia][color=#6aa84f][size=3]Content[/size][/color][/font][/b][/center]
﻿The mod adds a small bridge that travels from the beach to Blue Moon Vineyard, replacing the standard path. While the scenery seems to not match up, if you look at the map, the walk to the Vineyard is actually much longer, so... pretend like the bridge is longer if this upsets you 😇. And yes, your horse [i]can[/i] travel with you.

[b][center][font=Georgia][color=#6aa84f][size=3]Installation[/size][/color][/font][/center][/b]
Like any other CP mod! Don't worry.
[center][font=Georgia][color=#6aa84f][size=3][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color][/font][/center]
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14158]Sydney﻿ - A Custom NPC[/url][b] - [/b]Completely compatible, map specially patched just for her.
[*] ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] - Required, silly!
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]﻿ - Compatible!*﻿
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url][b] - [/b]Compatible[b]*[/b]
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]Starblue Valley[/url] - Compatible*
[/list]
Any major incompatibilities? Don't hesitate to let me know!

* - 99% Compatible- Some tiles lose their recolor at festivals, nothing game breaking (It's really only noticeable at the Luau; if anyone has a fix please let me know!﻿ 😇)
